ayahs.arabic: حمٓ
ayahs.translit: Hameem

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Ha, Meem

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.translit: Waalkitabi almubeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the clear Book

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيࣰّ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna jaAAalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
ayahs.translit: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom

ayahs.arabic: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.translit: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيࣲّ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him

ayahs.arabic: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلࣰ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرࣲ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

ayahs.arabic: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful

ayahs.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتࣲ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلࣰ ا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدࣰّ ا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.translit: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief

ayahs.arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبࣰ ا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةࣲ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةࣲ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةࣲ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following

ayahs.arabic: ۞قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.translit: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةࣰ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it]

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرࣱ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities

ayahs.arabic: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضࣲ دَرَجَٰتࣲ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضࣰ ا سُخۡرِيࣰّ اۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفࣰ ا مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

ayahs.arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبࣰ ا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.translit: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

ayahs.arabic: وَزُخۡرُفࣰ اۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنࣰ ا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
ayahs.translit: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion

ayahs.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment

ayahs.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error

ayahs.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them

ayahs.arabic: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرࣱ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned

ayahs.arabic: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةࣰ يُعۡبَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith]

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word

ayahs.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينࣱ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
ayahs.translit: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear

ayahs.arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةࣱ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah]

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفࣰ ا وَمَثَلࣰ ا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
ayahs.translit: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute

ayahs.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلࣰ ا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.translit: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمࣱ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.translit: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path

ayahs.arabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day

ayahs.arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةࣰ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not

ayahs.arabic: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

ayahs.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims

ayahs.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted

ayahs.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافࣲ مِّن ذَهَبࣲ وَأَكۡوَابࣲۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally

ayahs.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do

ayahs.arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ كَثِيرَةࣱ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
ayahs.translit: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.translit: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan]

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣱ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers

ayahs.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهࣱ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهࣱۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمࣱۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know
